# pr-2002: gh-1984 [GOAL] Media-slots parity для plain fa CLI: vision/transcribe/media слоты регистрируют inspect_image+transcribe_audio на всех хостах (сегодня — только app-раннер), image read auto-route через vision-модель, честные read-notes

## Description

Closes #1984
### What changed
Media-slot parity for the plain `fa` CLI (gh-1984): the persisted `models:` slots (`vision`, `transcription`) now register `inspect_image`/`transcribe_audio` on every host (plain CLI + headless), not only via flags; an image `read` under a non-vision chat model auto-routes through the configured vision model and returns its description inline with a `[via vision model <id>]` marker; audio/video reads get honest notes naming the tool, the slot to configure, or the host that reads the media.

### Key decisions
- ONE persisted source: `models.slots.vision` / `models.slots.transcription` (the schema the app and `/models set` write) resolve into `InspectImageConfig`/`TranscribeAudioConfig` per read via new adapters (`lib/src/tools/media_slot_configs.dart`); `--vision-model`/`--transcribe-model` stay overrides. Per-read resolution makes `/models set` edits (and a later-arriving key) apply without a restart.
- `useMainConnection: true` slots do NOT serve `inspect_image`: the main connection's model is the chat model — the slot must name its own endpoint.
- The auto-route replaces the bare omission note on success (description inline, no image payload — the chat model cannot use it); provider errors/cancel-budget/`maxBytesPerRequest` overruns degrade to the omission note + reason, never a failed read. Cancellation mid-call rethrows `CancelledException`. Redaction rides the existing `afterToolCall` pipeline (tool results already pass through `attachRedactionPipeline`).
- New `images.autoInspect` knob (default `true`) disables the auto-route; the note then names `inspect_image` + the vision model id so the agent can call it deliberately.
- Auto-route spend joins `/cost` via `UsageAccumulator.addSideCall` (tokens + cost, no turn-count bump), wired as the default sink in `AgentCli`.
- Audio/video notes are a host opt-in (`mediaFileReadNotes`): the app (its `transcriptionTool`/`read_video` differ) keeps today's byte-identical read behavior — REG AC7.
- `/tools` absent-reasons name the slot and the flag for each media tool.

### How to verify
```bash
dart analyze lib bin test
dart test test/tools/builtin_tools_test.dart test/tools/media_slot_configs_test.dart test/tools/inspect_image_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_config_test.dart test/usage_summary_test.dart
# full gate:
dart test --exclude-tags integration
```

<details><summary>Read auto-route flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  R[read image.png] --> V{chat model has image input?}
  V -->|yes| RIDE[image rides in place — unchanged]
  V -->|no| S{models.slots.vision set?}
  S -->|no| NOTE1[omission note + how to configure vision]
  S -->|yes| A{images.autoInspect?}
  A -->|false| NOTE2[omission note + inspect_image + model id]
  A -->|true| B{image within maxBytesPerRequest?}
  B -->|no| NOTE3[omission note + budget reason]
  B -->|yes| VM[vision model call — once] -->|ok| DESC[description + via vision model marker]
  VM -->|error / cancel| DEGRADE[omission note + reason / rethrow cancel]
```

</details>

# PR #2002 rework — gh-1984 media-slots parity (threads 9 + 10 + red `guards` leg)

## Issues/Notes

Two open review threads + one red CI leg, all fixed on this pass:

1. **`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6yAV88` (IMPORTANT)** — `_syncInspectImageTool` re-registered `inspect_image` WITHOUT the `/cost` sink, so a live-registered (or remove→re-set) tool never reported its spend to `/cost`, unlike the boot path (`host_agent_wiring.dart` passes `onUsage: services.onImageInspectUsage`).
2. **`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6yAWAC` (SUGGESTION)** — `cliVisionSlotResolver`/`cliTranscriptionSlotResolver` captured the BOOT main connection (`mainBaseUrl: model.baseUrl, mainApiKey: apiKey`); after a mid-session `/provider` switch, `inspect_image`/`transcribe_audio` same-host slots kept authenticating with the boot key while `generate_image`/`generate_video` ride the live accessor (`MediaToolServices(mainApiKey: () => _apiKey)`).
3. **CI red `guards` leg (root cause of both failed checks)** — the Quality gate failed because its `guards` leg was red, and the guards leg ("CRAP + duplication") failed at its LAST step: `crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc` → `[FAIL] loc: 1/1064 files over their limit — test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart: 3066 lines > max 2800` (the gh-1984 tests added ~309 lines to a file already near the whole-tree ceiling). `ci_violations.json` attributed no path (`owned: 0, unknown: 2`) but the failing file is in this PR's diff, so it is owned here and fixed here: the six gh-1984 CLI tests moved verbatim into a new `test/cli/agent_cli_media_slots_test.dart` (the repo's per-topic split convention, e.g. `agent_cli_images_command_test.dart`). No production line counts moved.

Owned CI violation accounting (per the rework rules): `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` loc **fixed** (3066 → 2770 lines; new file 423 lines; `loc: 1065 files within 1065 limits` locally with the CI-pinned crap4dart 0.15.0). The second "unknown" error line is the same guards job's aggregate exit (the Quality gate verdict mirroring `guards = failure`) — no separate root cause.

## Approach

TDD, one RED-GREEN cycle per thread:

- **Thread 9 — the sync site keeps the /cost sink.** RED first: a test boots with the vision slot withdrawn (no `inspect_image` registered), flips the live resolver to serve, `/tools reload` registers the tool through `_syncInspectImageTool`, executes it against a scripted provider reporting `total_tokens: 1242` — and asserts `/stats` shows `total tokens: 1242`. Confirmed RED (`total tokens: 0`) before the fix. GREEN: `_syncInspectImageTool` passes `onUsage: _readOnImageUsage` — the same default getter the sqlite-swap read tool rides (`config.onImageInspectUsage ?? _usage.addSideCall`), identical to the boot path's `services.onImageInspectUsage`. Side note fixed by rewording the `_toolsWiring.resolvedVision` doc (no boot-config fallback claim for the pre-first-rebuild window; states why the window is not user-visible).
- **Thread 10 — live main-connection accessors.** RED first: builder tests asserting the same-host key match re-points when the accessors' backing values change mid-session (cross-host against boot, same-host after the switch; the transcription twin) — compile-red against the old `String` parameters, then GREEN by changing `cliVisionSlotResolver`/`cliTranscriptionSlotResolver` to `String Function()` accessors read INSIDE the returned closure. The executable backs them with `mediaMainConnection?.agent.state.model.baseUrl ?? model.baseUrl` / `mediaMainConnection?.apiKey ?? apiKey` (boot-resolved pair until the CLI exists — the eager boot resolution runs first — then the live CLI; set right after construction). The flag path's `fallback:` main key rides the live accessor too. New read-only `AgentCli.apiKey` getter exposes the live `_apiKey` seam. No behavior change for a normal boot.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` — `_syncInspectImageTool` passes `onUsage: _readOnImageUsage` (thread 9); `resolvedVision` doc reworded.
- `lib/src/tools/media_slot_configs.dart` — `cliVisionSlotResolver`/`cliTranscriptionSlotResolver` take live `String Function()` main-connection accessors (thread 10), docs updated.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — new read-only `apiKey` getter (the live-key seam, doc'd).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — `liveMainBaseUrl`/`liveMainApiKey` accessors backed by the live CLI (`mediaMainConnection`, set after construction); both resolver builders + both flag `fallback:` keys wired to them (thread 10).
- `test/cli/agent_cli_media_slots_test.dart` — NEW: the six gh-1984 CLI tests moved verbatim from `agent_cli_test.dart` (loc-ceiling fix) + the new thread-9 test; a narrowed local `cliFor` helper.
- `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — the moved block removed (3066 → 2770 lines, under the 2800 ceiling); now-unused imports dropped.
- `test/tools/media_slot_configs_test.dart` — builder call sites updated to accessor form + two new live-accessor tests (thread 10).

## Test Coverage

- `dart analyze lib bin test` — clean.
- `dart format` — clean on every touched file (pre-commit staged-file self-heal contract).
- Loc gate (the CI red, reproduced locally with CI-pinned crap4dart 0.15.0): `dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc` → `[PASS] loc: 1065 files within 1065 limits`. CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze`) → `Max CRAP: 0.00 — OK (threshold: 12.00)`.
- New regression tests (both RED before their fix, GREEN after):
  - `gh-1984: a live-registered inspect_image keeps the /cost sink (review thread 9)` — `test/cli/agent_cli_media_slots_test.dart`.
  - `flagless: the main connection is read LIVE per resolution (a /provider switch re-points the same-host match — review thread 10)` + `flagless: the transcription main connection is read LIVE too (review thread 10)` — `test/tools/media_slot_configs_test.dart`.
- Targeted suites: `test/cli/agent_cli_media_slots_test.dart` (7), `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` + `test/tools/media_slot_configs_test.dart` + `test/tools/inspect_image_test.dart` + `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/usage_summary_test.dart` (275 total) — green.
- Full gate: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — {{FULL_SUITE_RESULT}}.

The app host is untouched (REG AC7 holds: `flutter_app/` reads nothing changed here — `cliVisionSlotResolver`/`cliTranscriptionSlotResolver` have no callers outside `bin/` + `test/`).
